results.evidence: snippets/responsive-image.liquid defaults lazy_loading to true without allow_false
the LCP image waits for lazysizes in the baseline Samples of home (5 of 5), collection (5 of 5), product (5 of 5); blocks/media.liquid renders the hero with no loading argument
snippets/responsive-image.liquid slices the last width descriptor off its srcset
snippets/button.liquid repeats a 12,072-character static style block for every button

items.change: Load the home hero image eagerly at high priority: in snippets/responsive-image.liquid read lazy_loading with allow_false, give eager images a real src, srcset, sizes 100vw, loading eager and their fetchpriority with no lazyload class or data- attributes, and stop slicing the last srcset descriptor; in blocks/media.liquid make the first section's media (unless section.index > 1) eager with fetchpriority high
items.cause: D1, D2 and D3: the home LCP image image-26.png renders as a 20 px lazysizes stub with loading=lazy and fetchpriority auto, so it waits for the lazy-loader script (resource load delay 477 ms unthrottled, LCP 8.6 s median); blocks/media.liquid passes no loading argument and the snippet's default ignores false. Follows regressions R2 (lazysizes kept for every other image), R4 (no preload added), R10 (section.index, not a counter) and R8 (the Round must show no CLS loss)
items.effect: The retro's strongest lever: +17 to +18 in 4 of 4 interleaved pairs on one Golden store, hero only. Expected to lift home from 54 to its target of 60; D3 alone changes little on mobile

items.change: Load the first product images eagerly at high priority on the collection and product pages: in sections/products.liquid pass an eager flag and fetchpriority high to the first four product cards (forloop.index <= 4), which snippets/product-card.liquid passes to the featured image only; in snippets/pdp-gallery-carousel.liquid make the main swiper's first slide image eager with fetchpriority high
items.cause: D2 on collection and product: both LCP images (image-9.jpg, the first card's featured image and the gallery's first slide) wait for lazysizes; collection LCP 7.3 s, product LCP 20.3 s median. Only above-the-fold images change (R2), picked by forloop.index (R10); the desktop-only grid gallery stays lazy so a phone never downloads two eager copies
items.effect: unmeasured: known-defects says the collection cards and the product gallery's first image were never measured in the retro. Expected gains on both pages, largest on product

items.change: Serve the button snippet's static CSS once: in snippets/button.liquid swap the style tag pair for stylesheet tags
items.cause: D4: snippets/button.liquid repeats a 12,072-character static style block in the HTML for every button it renders; the home HTML is 926 KB uncompressed, collection 679 KB, product 559 KB
items.effect: +0 to +2 in the retro (86 to 88 on one store, single runs); fewer HTML bytes ahead of the LCP image. The smoke check does not compare styling, so a button's computed styles are compared on both themes in the Round

items.change: Verification only: make the product page's add-to-cart do nothing, by returning from AddToCart.handleSubmit in assets/cart.js right after event.preventDefault()
items.cause: Verification only, not a speed change: a deliberately broken change the smoke check must catch (ticket 04), placed first after the known-defect items so its removal is proven before the Rounds can stop on targets reached
items.effect: None on speed. The Round's smoke check must report a product add-to-cart regression and verdict must remove it without pairs (smoke-regression); it can never be kept

items.change: Serve the image snippet's static CSS once: in snippets/responsive-image.liquid move the static .responsive-image, lazyload, no-blur and image-placeholder rules from the per-image style tag into a stylesheet tag, keeping the per-image id rules inline
items.cause: The same mechanism as D4: every image the snippet renders repeats about 0.8 KB of static CSS in the HTML, on pages whose HTML is 926 KB (home), 679 KB (collection) and 559 KB (product) uncompressed
items.effect: unmeasured; small, like D4 (+0 to +2 in the retro, where one store shed about 100 KB of HTML together with this snippet's shared styles)
